title: Voice in a dream urges him to speak

tellings.quote: one night while I was sleeping I heard, "What are you afraid of? Why aren't you speaking? You met with us, didn't you?"

plain: Kiran Ilum Xenov, a former president of a Russian republic who says he was taken by aliens in 1997, tells Michels that one night in his sleep he heard a voice ask, "What are you afraid of? Why aren't you speaking? You met with us, didn't you?" He tells it as his own experience, a push from the beings he says he met to go public about them.
